name: 'Ard 'Ead
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with the general's 'Eadbutt until the end of the turn.

name: Humongous Strides
text: Add 1 to the general's charge rolls.

name: Lucky Rock
text: Once per battle, in your shooting phase, the general's Hurlin' Rocks have +1 Attacks until the end of the turn.

name: Hungry Gobbler
text: At the end of any turn, if the general's combat attacks slew at least one enemy model this turn, Heal (D3) the general.
